description.value: Little Thai Place has served authentic Thai cuisine in Victoria since 2003, operated by a Bangkok family with a strong local reputation for fresh ingredients, house-made sauces, and consistent quality. The Shelbourne Plaza location has since been rebranded as Thai Orchid Restaurant under the same ownership, with a refreshed menu while retaining many classic dishes. The broader Little Thai Place brand holds two active locations (Cook Street and Royal Oak) and has been voted Best Thai in the city.

The two active Little Thai Place locations are Cook Street and Royal Oak; the Shelbourne address is now Thai Orchid.
